properties.inspection_comments: Purpose: To conduct a food safety inspection in accordance with WAC Chapter 246-215. Due to 35 or more red points, a follow-up inspection will be conducted for the red item violations noted in this inspection report. A fee of $240 will be assessed by mail for all follow-up inspections. If repeated red item violations are observed at a follow-up inspection, an additional follow-up inspection will be required. Notes: - Continue to work on getting a Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM). - Ensure after handling raw food to remove gloves, wash hands and put on new gloves before handling ready to eat foods such as limes.
